name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.39.0: pairing codes, so a new machine can be set up without adb. The device code and machine key used to go in as intent extras, which only adb can send, so every machine needed someone on site with a laptop - and the key kept ending up in shell history and chat. Now an AG admin generates a six-digit code on the machine's page, someone types it on the kiosk, and POST /api/v1/provisioning/pair exchanges it for { deviceCode, machineKey } over TLS. No human ever reads the key. The exchange endpoint is unauthenticated by necessity - the machine has no key yet - so: codes are single-use and expire in 24 hours, generating a new one supersedes any live code for that machine, redemption is a conditional UPDATE so two devices racing cannot both win, digits come from crypto.randomBytes with the modulo bias rejected, and unknown, malformed, expired and already-used codes all answer an identical 404 invalid_code so the endpoint is not an oracle over a million values. Rate limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP and 60 overall. Redeeming rotates the machine key, which retires anything that leaked previously. Issuing and reading codes is ag_admin only; verified operator_admin gets 403 and no auth gets 401. Cumulative over v6.38.0.
